sightings.note: found next to the diamond exhibit. the diamond was for sale. he was not.
plaque reads: petrified holder, est. 2026. nobody remembers bringing him in.
session 1. he sat down and never got up. the therapist billed 70 years.
logs float. he didn't know. now he does.
the lights were on. the saw was running. he was just standing there.

sightings.place: a living room with a fireplace
sightings.note: he stood as far from the fire as the room allowed. he didn't say anything.
the belly is a ring. every lock adds one. you don't have to cut him down to count. they're on chain.
carrying today's log to the pile. it doesn't go down. it goes on the pile.
mid-lignification. the bark had reached his chest. the leaf hadn't come in yet.
the bark is halfway up. he says it's fine. it is fine.
fifteen logs. nobody took any. nobody can, for 70 years.
reading the flog log again. it still says locked.

sightings.place: a misty forest, the old court
sightings.note: aesop wrote this one down a long time ago. the log is still sitting there.
the cousin was frozen solid. flog waited with him. he's good at waiting.
sailors threw a log on a knotted rope and wrote down the knots. he volunteered.
four jumped. one stayed. you know which one.
day 30. still sitting. still a bump on a log.

memes.caption: diamonds can be sold / wood can't
stage 5: petrified. they put him in a museum. he didn't notice
flog at therapy: / 'i can't feel my hands' / 'they're wood' / 'oh'
flog tried to swim. he just floated.
flog at the sawmill. 3am. cutting logs. no hands.
count the rings / every lock adds one
it's not a bag / it's a log
doctor: it's stage 4 lignification / me: is that bullish
me explaining to my wife why i'm turning into a log
every ~2 SOL another log hits the pile. the pile doesn't sell.
don't trust the frog. check the log.
the frogs asked for a king. they got a log. it never did anything. best king they ever had.
there's a real frog that stops its heart all winter and wakes up fine. flog's cousin. he's seen worse charts.
the first log book was an actual log. we do the same thing. it's called the flog log.
five little speckled frogs sat on a speckled log. four jumped in the pool. one stayed. he's the log now.
"sitting there for thirty days like a bump on a log." / - mark twain, 1863, describing a holder

videos.title: the lignification
videos.caption: he bought a coin and sat on a log. it dipped. it pumped. it did nothing. he kept sitting. stage 4: log.

videos.title: the flog machine
videos.caption: fees in. logs up. every log locked 70 years on streamflow. operators are not standing by. the sawmill is.
